packages.title: BF16/FP32成熟算术与DOT4

source.binding: Executed uncommitted immutable v6/v7 ZIPs with exact RTL/bench/fixture/constraint SHA; N64 synthesis reused with full equivalence proof; supplemental STA separately frozen; published source blobs verified against ZIP.

packages.boundary: Specialized FPnew BF16xBF16/FP32; non-fused folded DOT4 full N64 includes four FP32 contexts and final reduction. No SRAM, operand stream generation, RNG, quantization/format frontends, CTS/SDF/SPEF/physical wires. Synthetic3seeds, not LLM traces/PPL. Timing and power are prelayout, not silicon signoff.

packages.name: int8_classic_ppa_20261028
packages.title: 四lane经典INT8

source.binding: Immutable uncommitted execution ZIP/manifests with all RTL/bench/fixture/constraint SHA. Final v4 copied publicly byte-for-byte; v1/v2 failures and v3 intermediate functional checks retained.

packages.boundary: N64 one-output compute core: four INT8 products with product pipeline, balanced integer reduction, output-stationary AW32/AW22 sum and control. Async control reset with4.5..5.5ns release contract; synchronous sum reset; product flops valid-masked and not reset. No input/weight memory, output conversion, RNG, real broadcast, ICG/CTS/SDF/SPEF. Synthetic inputs; no model/PPL or silicon signoff.

packages.name: int8_parallel64_20261028
packages.title: 同64路并行INT8

source.binding: Immutable v1/v2 uncommitted execution ZIPs; all manifest files checked. Final public source byte-identical to v2, fixtures recoverable/generatable from source package.

packages.boundary: Same64 input lanes/M1,64 full signed8 multipliers and balanced reduction; registered22/32 output. No temporal multiplier sharing, external weight/input storage and sign/probability/RNG/format/physical broadcast/ICG/CTS/SDF/SPEF excluded. Paced clock remains free-running; do not call it optimal gated digital energy.
